response_raw: All 7 tests pass. The bug was that `distance = elem - elem2` produced negative values when `elem < elem2`, causing the `< threshold` check to incorrectly return `True`. The fix wraps it in `abs()` so only the actual magnitude of the difference is compared against the threshold.

All tests pass. The fix was changing `current_depth < 0` to `current_depth == 0` on line 17 — a group is complete when its parentheses balance back to zero, not when depth goes negative (which would never happen with valid input).
All tests pass. The fix was simple: `truncate_number` was returning `number % 1.0 + 1.0` (adding an erroneous `+ 1.0`), when it should return just `number % 1.0` — the fractional part of the number.
